mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (3-month change) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS (3-month change) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5%, it signals a tight labor market that accelerates consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5% or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising federal funds rate and accelerating inflation (FEDFUNDS > CPIAUCSL) indicates tightening real rates, suppressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with FEDFUNDS > CPIAUCSL or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle regimes (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL growth > 2.0%), strong economic momentum triggers profit-taking and rate sensitivity, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with rising INDPRO (3-month change) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly payroll employment growth exceeds 200,000 jobs, it signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with PAYEMS growth > 200,000 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening regimes (FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and accelerating), higher discount rates suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
